title: Arbitrary File Upload Leading to Remote Execution

references.name: SANS - Web Application File Upload Risks

description: Improper upload handling allows placement of executable content in a webroot or script-interpreted directory, resulting in remote code execution.
businessImpact: High --- leads to full compromise of web or file servers, potential lateral movement, and disruption of the organization's infrastructure and services.
remediation:
- Validate uploaded file types and block executable content.
- Enforce non-executable storage and sandbox uploads.
- Harden web server handlers and disable risky modules.
- Scan uploads and separate privileges for upload services.
